stateNote: The user is typing into an adaptive canvas; the text may be mid-sentence. The interface rearranges itself to fit what the user seems to be doing. Prefer stability: keep a fitting element unless the text has clearly moved on.

intent.instructions: What is the user most likely doing with this text?

criteria.analyze-data: describing or asking about numbers, metrics, trends, or a dataset
criteria.write-document: drafting prose, notes, an article, or documentation
criteria.monitor-status: watching a system, service, or ongoing process
criteria.plan-work: making a to-do list, planning one's own work steps, or scheduling tasks
criteria.report-issue: describing a problem, bug, alert, or something broken
criteria.check-social: casually asking what friends, contacts, a group, or 'everyone' is doing or up to; checking a social feed, group activity, or messages
criteria.explore: just exploring, chatting, or no clear task yet

layout.instructions: Which overall page layout fits best right now?

criteria.empty: nothing useful to show yet; keep the stage mostly empty
criteria.dashboard: several information cards in a grid
criteria.split: input echo on one side, supporting panels on the other

density.instructions: How much information should be on screen? 0 = almost nothing, 4 = dense dashboard.

emphasis.instructions: If several elements are shown, which one deserves the most visual emphasis?

nav-rail.desc: the app navigation rail listing all sections, highlighting the active one
nav-rail.ask: Should the UI show the app navigation rail?

intent-chip.desc: a small chip showing the detected intent and confidence
intent-chip.ask: Should the UI show a small readout of the detected intent?

summary-card.desc: a card summarizing the input text itself (length, words, language)
summary-card.ask: Should the UI show a summary/statistics card about the text being typed?

metric-card.desc: a KPI card with one big number and a trend arrow
metric-card.ask: Should the UI show a single highlighted numeric metric (KPI card)?

bind.question: Which dataset should the metric card display?

chart-card.desc: a line/bar chart of a trend over time
chart-card.ask: Should the UI show a trend chart?

bind.question: Which dataset should the chart display?

table-card.desc: a compact table of detail rows
table-card.ask: Should the UI show a detail table of rows?

bind.question: Which dataset should the table display?

alert-banner.desc: a full-width warning/alert strip for something urgent or broken
alert-banner.ask: Should the UI show a prominent alert/warning banner?

action-bar.desc: a row of contextual action buttons (run, export, share...)
action-bar.ask: Should the UI show a row of contextual action buttons?

timeline-card.desc: a vertical timeline of steps or events
timeline-card.ask: Should the UI show a timeline of steps or events?

note-card.desc: a sticky-note style card for a quote, reminder, or aside
note-card.ask: Should the UI show a sticky note / aside card?

feed-card.desc: a feed of friends' recent posts with avatars, text, time and likes
feed-card.ask: Should the UI show a social feed of friends' recent posts?

hero-stat.desc: a very large centered headline number
hero-stat.ask: Should the UI show one huge centered headline number?

bind.question: Which dataset should the hero number come from?

progress-card.ask: Should the UI show a progress indicator?

photos.cue: Is the user writing a personal diary or journal entry? Show today's photos to accompany it.

news.cue: Is the user drafting an article, essay or news-related writing? Show recent news headlines for reference.

items.title: Pointer-head decision models for adaptive interfaces
Why JSON generation is the wrong interface for UI
Ambient computing: interfaces that assemble themselves

logs.cue: Is the user debugging an error, outage or incident? Show recent error log lines to help.

tasks.cue: Is the user planning their own work or making a to-do list? Show today's task list.

datasets.cue: Is the user asking about data, metrics or trends? Show quick dataset pickers.

moments.cue: Is the user casually asking what other people or friends are doing right now (e.g. 'what is everyone up to'), or checking a social feed? Show the friends' recent posts feed.
